newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to invest C$87 mln in Bombardier.
newsitem.headline: Canada to invest C$87 mln in Bombardier.

text.p: The federal government will invest C$87 million in Bombardier Inc's 70-passenger regional jet program under its Techonolgy Partnership Canada scheme.
The money will support research and development to improve fuel efficiency and performance of the CRJ-X regional jet, Industry Minister John Manley said on Monday.
The funds are repayable on a royalty basis.
"The government is in the company's new jet," Manley said at a ceremony at Bombardier's Dorval plant.
"The project will benefit suppliers across Canada and will maintain or create 1,000 jobs in Montreal," Manley said.
Bombardier is expected to announce the full go-ahead with the 70-seater Regional Jet, an expanded version of the existing 50-passenger version, by year-end.
Negotiations for partnerships and financing are in the final stages, said Bombardier officials.
The federal government's investment will focus on systems and wing modification.
Total research and development cost of the 70-seater is estimated to be roughly C$350 million.
